issues.description: The template implementation of simulate_msd_one_round has a return type annotation of list[float], but the problem statement and the solution implementation specify and use a tuple[float, float] (error rate, acceptance rate). This mismatch could confuse students about the expected return value and cause type/usage inconsistencies when writing or testing their implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the return type annotation of simulate_msd_one_round in the template msd.py from list[float] to tuple[float, float] to match the problem statement and the solution. Ensure the docstring and any example usages in the template also describe the returned tuple (error_rate, acceptance_rate).
